newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen B shares fall at noon in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares fall at noon in dull trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index edged down at midday on Friday, with most investors keeping low profiles before B share companies start releasing their 1997 interim results, brokers said.
The index slipped 1.43 points or 1.08 percent to 131.15 points on turnover of HK$10.4 million
The domestic A share index fell 5.54 points or 1.35 percent to 404.89 points on turnover of 2.6 billion yuan.
"B share investors are still waiting for interim results. There is no major market-moving news," a broker at China Guotai Securities said. "Trading is inactive."
None of the 49 Shenzhen-listed B share firms has released its 1997 interim results. The official deadline is August 30.
On the B share market, Jiangling Motors was the biggest loser, sliding HK$0.20 or 7.1 percent to HK$2.60.
Brokers said the selling of A shares was mainly based on technical indicators which signalled further downward pressure.
Shandong Shengli Co, which is chiefly engaged in petroleum trade, dropped 1.40 yuan or 7.49 percent to 17.30 yuan to become the morning's worst performer.
